component.name: Venus Pro Config
component.summary: Configure supported UtechSmart Venus MMO mice

description.p: Venus Pro Config is a Linux utility for configuring supported UtechSmart Venus MMO mice. It supports the wireless receiver, wired Areson model, and the separately detected Holtek controller.

ul.li: Controller-aware remapping for 16 Areson or 19 Holtek controls
Hardware macro recording, reordering, and slot management
Text macros with fixed or randomized key timing
Native left, right, middle, back, and forward mouse events in macros
Battery and cable status in the desktop tray
RGB lighting configuration (Neon, Breathing, Steady, speed, and brightness)
Controller-aware DPI stages and profile settings

screenshot.caption: Text macro editor with fixed and randomized timing
Manual keyboard and mouse macro events

description.p: Fixes non-root access to the mouse.

ul.li: The udev rule is now installed as 70-venus-pro.rules, so systemd grants the desktop user access to the mouse.
install.sh installs the full application and removes files left by older versions.

description.p: Feature parity with the Windows driver, and packaging fixes.

ul.li: Media keys cover the Windows driver's full consumer key set.
DPI stages use the driver's per-sensor tables, fixing custom stages above 8000 DPI.
Debian, Fedora, Flatpak and portable packages include every module the window needs.
